newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK June PMI services survey.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK June PMI services survey.

text.p: Following is a selection of comments from analysts on the PMI UK services sector survey for June -

The prevailing climate in the market after the disappointment on the budget yesterday is going to be one where people remain concerned about the pace of growth in the economy and the extent to which that is sustainable and certainly everyone is going to be expecting rate increases from the Bank.
